steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?
Will it keep earning above market profits?
Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In February 2025, a guest on Equity Mates discussed Insignia being in a takeover situation with about three parties bidding, likening it to an auction where competition can push the price up. It noted the risk that takeovers sometimes fall through; shares traded at $4.60.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Dawes - Xero, Pilbara Minerals, Resmed & more
